WE’RE HIRING | Lead AI Engineer – Agentic Systems | Pharma

📍 Bengaluru | Hybrid — 4 Days
Experience: 6–9 Years
Job Type: Full-Time
Joining: Immediate — Within 1 Week

Key Skills:
• Python, AWS, Azure, GCP
• LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain
• Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems
• RAG, RAGAS & Retrieval Evaluation
• OpenAI Assistants API & Anthropic Claude API
• Vertex AI Agent Builder
• Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector
• Neo4j, Amazon Neptune
• LangSmith, Helicone & AI Observability
• Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, CDK
• MCP
• IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo, Veeva, Medidata
• Pharma & Life Sciences AI

What You’ll Work On:
• Design and implement agentic AI pipelines including multi-agent graphs, tool orchestration, retrieval modules and memory systems.
• Own subsystem designs covering agent topology, data flows, API contracts and failure handling.
• Build and optimize production RAG pipelines across ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, evaluation and latency tuning.
• Integrate agentic systems with pharma data platforms such as IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo and Veeva.
• Build observability using trace logging, cost metrics, drift alerts and evaluation frameworks with LangSmith, Helicone or equivalent tools.
• Lead CI/CD for owned modules, including Docker/Kubernetes deployments, automated testing, staging gates and rollback procedures.
• Translate medical affairs, commercial analytics and clinical operations requirements into technical AI component specifications.
• Apply 21 CFR Part 11 auditability, HIPAA-compatible data handling and GxP traceability patterns.
• Build intelligent document processing pipelines for drug labels, clinical study reports, HEOR dossiers and regulatory submissions.
• Contribute to KOL mapping, competitive intelligence and signal detection agents.
• Guide AI Engineers through code reviews, architecture decisions and complex implementation challenges.
• Lead component-level design reviews and identify architecture risks early.
• Represent engineering quality in client-facing technical discussions and communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly.
• Contribute reference implementations and guardrail templates to the internal agentic AI playbook.

What We’re Looking For:
Candidates with 6–9 years of engineering experience and strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering, agentic systems, RAG and cloud-native development.

Experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences environments, along with exposure to platforms such as IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo, Veeva or Medidata, will be highly relevant.

This role requires an immediate joiner who can start within the next week.

Apply here: https://lnkd.in/gZFgv8CS
